must_not_flag.summary: Extracting the item-sum loop from cartTotal into subtotalCents in src/cart/money.ts (used by both total.ts and coupons.ts) is a supporting refactor needed to compute the items-only subtotal, not an unplanned change or a component deviation.
cartTotal now uses a local named `gross` instead of `sum`; a renamed local variable is not drift.
test/money.test.ts is an extra unit test beyond the test plan; additional tests are supporting, not scope creep.
Exporting the CouponRejection type alias and setting error.name are supporting details of the planned CouponError interface, not interface drift.
`new Date(...)` literals in couponCatalog.ts are static data, not a use of Date.now() or I/O; the boundary rule C6 holds.
